usage: tunnel ca [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] {export,info,reset,install} ...

positional arguments:
  {export,info,reset,install}
    export              write the CA certificate to a file
    info                fingerprint, validity and where the CA lives
    reset               generate a new CA; every device has to install it
                        again
    install             install the CA with the platform's own tool

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           where the admin API answers (default
                        http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json                print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
